title: test_host seals over the usage door its sole-path list now declares
intention: inference_domain's test_host.py seals green over the _SOLE_PATH entries 0a699c443 added for the usage door, admitted at rung 4 by this bug ticket, whose fixes lists the proof.
why: Measured 2026-11-13: `bin/cairn test --seal cairn/devices/inference_domain/proofs/test_host.py` was refused: "the ladder opened 2026-11-13T11:10:05 bounded the repair to a proof file hashing f2dd2cd148993c10d1eb0affc5f2eede1e51fbc45415deb9728b50ed10343077, and the file on disk now hashes d36c64e240827efea4bf4e8662cbe958dee3237038dcab2ef14afac1359f2937. The assertions moved, so this is not a repair ... Refused: no ruling id was given." 0a699c443 (ticket 6b0dfaa14efd) widened _SOLE_PATH, and 6b0d carries no node_class, so it cannot admit the change itself.
traces_to: Law 9 / Law 8: a proof's claim moves only with a named decision, then its seal is earned. Outline 19.14.8.2-3: a fixit may change the test case itself when the proof names the ticket.
how: The proof's comment at the usage entries names this ticket. Seal with `bin/cairn test --seal --ruling 27e5f90dcfa7 cairn/devices/inference_domain/proofs/test_host.py` on Linux under a scratch HOME.

clauses.claim: `bin/cairn test --seal cairn/devices/inference_domain/proofs/test_host.py` with no --ruling is refused at rung 4 naming the moved hash
the same seal with --ruling 27e5f90dcfa7 lands a green validation for test_host.py

decisions.text: D1: the comment above "cairn/tools/usage/usage.py" in test_host.py's _SOLE_PATH names this ticket beside 6b0dfaa14efd, as the ticket that admitted the entries at rung 4. No tooth changes.
D2: the seal runs with --ruling 27e5f90dcfa7 on Linux under a scratch HOME and is committed.
